_help: v49.14 local sponsor spot on the desktop homepage ('This chisme brought to you by…'). Every entry shows a 'Sponsored' tag.
Fields: id (a-z, 0-9, dashes), name, url (https only), tagline (up to 140 chars), area (e.g. 'Southtown'), cta (button text),
image ('/static/…' or https), alt (image description), adult (true = beer / ice-house: only shown with the 21+ setting on),
active (false hides it), start / end ('YYYY-MM-DD', Chicago dates, both optional), weight (1-10, how often it's picked).
With no live sponsors the card says 'Your business here, reach local metiches' and links to Support / Contact.
Edit this file (or point SPONSORS_FILE at another one) and redeploy; the server re-reads it when it changes.
